metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.definition: Samples and calibrated zone shapes use the same coordinates in centimeters; zones are evaluated independently and include their boundary. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in social chamber
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the social chamber.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in object chamber
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the object chamber.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in center chamber
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the center chamber.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Sociability index
metrics.definition: Preference for the social chamber, from -1 (object) to +1 (social).
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when both chamber times are 0; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Social interaction time
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the social interaction zone.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZONE_NOT_PROVIDED) when the interaction zone is not calibrated; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Object interaction time
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the object interaction zone.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZONE_NOT_PROVIDED) when the interaction zone is not calibrated; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Social chamber entries
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Object chamber entries
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.
